description: Call one stable x402 service by slug. The first unpaid attempt returns an x402 Payment Required payload. Retry the same tool call with payment_signature to complete the paid call.

max_price_usdc.description: Optional safety bound. The tool errors if the quoted service exceeds this price.

payload.description: JSON payload sent to the stable edge route.

payment_signature.description: Optional PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value used on the paid retry.

slug.description: Stable x402 service slug, for example text-summarizer.

name: agoragentic_call_service
